name: Train Your Fingers - Lab
detailed_description:
A fast-paced typing game where you brew potions by typing words. Prepare the required number of potions within the time limit, cork them, and send them to customers. New potion types add fresh challenges—miss the timing, and spoiled potions block your shelf until you destroy them by typing again!

Step into the role of Akash, an orphan chosen to become the apprentice of a powerful mage. Uncover Akash’s story as you progress through lessons and master both the keyboard and the art of magic.

The faster and more accurately you type, the further you advance in the story. In the magical library, you uncover hidden tales from ancient books, while the Mage assigns you new tasks and teaches you to craft increasingly complex potions.

Under your mentor’s guidance, you unlock special spells and sharpen your skills toward true mastery. Every successfully typed line brings you one step closer to casting spells as effortlessly as moving your fingers.

In a game that blends perfecting your typing skills with an exciting magical adventure, your abilities will become second nature. Words will flow from your fingertips, and magic will come alive with every keystroke.

Embark on a journey where the power of words will shape your destiny.
